method: Native ACT=0 is background. Pad the finite crop with background, compute exact Euclidean distance from voxel centers to any background center, and subtract half the native voxel diagonal for a conservative occupied-cell surface clearance. Crop padding makes interior clearance a lower bound. Test the label inside the complete main tube enlarged by the maximum cumulative dilation budget (all swept distances and pass counts), a conservative superset of original selection and target growth. Reject an envelope that extends beyond the loaded crop. Internal ACT=0 cavities also count as background conservatively.
interpretation: This supports a manually reviewed interior-fill exception only for the recorded source/config envelope; it does not prove tissue histology or reclassify the entire original label. A per-label override changes stiffness throughout this config, but mutations remain limited to edit regions. Any enlarged/repositioned ROI or edit budget requires new evidence. Erosion recipient seed voxels remain unchanged; dilation can borrow donor voxels. No override or freeze is automatically approved.
